outcome.technical: (1) THE SWITCH: _floor_guard._switch(tree, binds), computed once per copy inside _bindings (binds['switch']) before any name is read, one breadth-first walk; on for an unproven namespace use at any depth (globals/locals/vars as a bare name or an attribute's last name, called or not, vars of a modules-table entry, that entry's __dict__), an exec or eval call, a star import, an attribute store or a setattr on a modules-table entry. When on, _resolve returns (None, None, 'nothing of the copy is proven: <what>, at line N') for every name, so no base is followed and no skip resolves, and _bound_by gives the one reason naming the first such line; _new_test_aside reads no computed scopes then. A setattr on any other object keeps its _COMPUTED class reading. (2) PROVEN LIST (_proven_use): the namespace handed directly, by position or keyword, to a callee whose first name resolves to an import at module level (the staged suites' globals() to their runner), and the namespace's own .get called. Sweep (scratch sg1.57/sweep_namespace.py, .out) over every test-like file: those two were the only own-namespace uses found; membership, comparison, subscript read, iteration, getattr/isinstance/len are not on the list (fm89 holds each as not compared); the sweep run for the switch (sweep_switch.py, .out) found the bare-exec files. Removed: _READING_METHODS, _WRITING_BUILTINS, _MODULE, _ESCAPES, _namespace_ref, _proven_callee, _read_in_place, _namespace_uses, _namespace_escape, _exec_call, _star_import, the star key, the escapes fact, _computed_scopes' module branch; _COMPUTED is one row (a setattr call). wc -l _floor_guard.py 2882 -> 2855. (3) SPELLING: _rows_spelled - a call is spelled like a SKIP_FORMS row only by its last name, or its last two for a dotted row; no '*' receiver row and no family row is spelled, so s.mark.get / mark.group are not marks. Step one, _reason_aside blanks only the reason position(s) and keywords of the rows spelled and records (owner, dumps held, why); step two, _unresolved_reason reports not compared only when that held reason differs and its owner is no changed def (a changed def is already a finding). Widened condition, changed assertion, new skip, deleted test are findings in every context (fx16). (4) BINDING_KINDS stated once in the module; GEN_REBINDINGS in the suite is keyed by those words - a store has six statement pairs, a del one (builtins-based), import/def/class/except/match one each, parameter/type parameter/global/nonlocal a reason; fx15 fails by name on a kind with neither and a row naming no kind; the match pair is a named counted skip before 3.10 (run under /usr/bin/python3 3.9: fx13 'skipping 1 pairs ... rebinding=a match capture on Python 3.9', 177/177). (5) SECOND PROPERTY fx16: GEN_MOVES (widened condition, changed assertion, new skip, deleted test, changed reason) x GEN_MOVE_CONTEXTS (one import, imported twice, star import, a local named for a mark or skip, a same-file function named skip) x unittest/pytest, 50 cells; oracle _move_expect(move, resolves) reads the move and the context's own resolves flag; _oracle_reads walks the AST of _move_expect, _move_pairs and _gen_failing and fails if any names M, _run or _floor_guard. Probes vs stored answers: q1 A1-A4, B1-B3, C1, C2 partly-read; H1 clean; H2 partly-read (not on the list: the sweep found no membership use); q5 every row findings; q7 K1-K5 findings with nothing not compared; q8 G1-G3 partly-read, G4 partly-read (getattr is not on the list); q3 answers identical. p1_rule, u1_unsafe, n2_shapes: answers unchanged, reason texts only. my_rows: M5 (subscripted to read) clean -> partly-read, allowed since no test file holds the form; the rest reason text. n1_noise and n2_classes: one flip each, tests/test_stamp_verification.py clean -> partly-read because line 906 calls exec into another module's __dict__ - judged an accepted cost of the switch (it cannot tell that dict from its own), direction toward not compared. Current-tree noise sweep (scratch noise_now.py, 208 rows): 3 flips, test_stamp_verification.py twice and tests/test__floor_guard.py (its _gen_failing exec), same judgment. MEASUREMENT (scratch measure.py, one producer, three guards, same 1199 task commits from HEAD): verdicts 68c5879 / b301c59f / this change all clean 274, findings 396, partly-read 529; findings by (commit, move, path, unit) lost 0, gained 0 against 68c5879 and against b301c59f. 11 commits move in notRead text only: the seven named in sg1.56's compare lose the false 'mark.get/mark.group spelled like a skip' clause (100beb3669 keeps a skip clause, now from the exec switch); four (95d5549a06, 46a6e095b0, d24b3047d5, 82174ff4a3) gain a 'reason not compared' clause because the switch is on in a labelled-check file; no verdict moves. The stored sg1.56 measure.after.json came from a producer not found in the scratchpad (1055 commits, a different declared reading), so it was not used as the baseline; compared anyway, 174 new rows and 327 moves, explained by declared handling, not by the guard. Mutation probe (scratch sg1.57/mutations.py, from the worktree root): EVERY ROW CAUGHT 49 of 49; red per row recorded in mutations.out, e.g. switch scope-by-scope -> fm86, fm89, fx13; .get removed -> fa60, fa61, fx13; form (i) removed -> fa59, fa60, fa61, fx13; Compare listed -> fm86, fm89, fx13; every argument set aside -> fm87, fx16; receiver named mark -> fm87, fx16; each _binds branch -> fx13 (parameter -> fm88, after adding a parameter head); BINDING_KINDS shortened -> fx15; oracles given the module's answer -> fx13, fx16; docs rows -> fx14. Two rows are judged equivalent and held by the suite staying green: the mark family spelled by prefix (it names no reason position) and the global/nonlocal branch (the store it enables is counted as a store). The probe found fx14 passing with a guide row removed because new prose said 'a metaclass hook'; the prose was reworded and each row now occurs once per passage. outcome.descriptive: The floor guard's proof is one switch per file and a short list of proven uses, and a name's resolution now decides only whether a skip's reason is set aside, so a condition or assertion change is a finding in any file.
